│     SaveService.poll_frame(): observes the last committed tick boundary; polls the worker; no presentation work
│
└─ PRESENTATION (0)  PipelineRoot._process = the single PresentationHost (ADR-0008 s6.1, ADR-0009 s3); presenters define no _process
      subscriber handlers (run in P5) only mark dirty: _dirty.absorb(batch); return ctx.complete()
      advance present_time → zoom cooldown → RESCALING re-derive if the layout is dirty → driver.frame(delta, present_time)
      driver.frame fills one PresentFrame (alpha read once, pos = floor(prev + (curr - prev) × frame.alpha)), then runs the stages in order:
        0 PROJECT (layout projector, body.projector, Lighting's occluder builder) → 1 CAMERA_SOLVE (CameraSolver: pose_q, f_q, jolt, parallax offsets, world_to_hud inputs; solved, not yet written)
        → 2 AVATAR (Avatar Presenter) → 3 FILTER (Perception Filter step, decoy list) → 4 INSTRUMENTS (perceived()) → 5 HUD (perceived(); world_to_hud with this frame's pose)
        → 6 LIGHTING → 7 TRAIL → 8 AUDIO → 9 DEBUG
      RenderingServer.frame_pre_draw (probed after every node _process, windowed 4.7.2 editor; release export unverified): writes canvas_transform and the parallax offsets only, from the already-solved pose
```

334	
335	The Adapter never predicts an outcome except body motion and sound (pre-play keyed by `correlation`); light and effects change only on committed state.
336	
337	### 3. Weld transaction (cross-system atomic write)
338	
339	```
340	begin_weld (PLAYER) ── validate (static predicates only: can_join_static, socket_plan, docked)
341	   └─ apply: Interaction.open_channel(seat, ASSEMBLY, verb, target, WELD_CHANNEL_TICKS=360)
342	interaction.step × 360 ticks (re-checks lit and reach every LIT_RECHECK_TICKS)
343	assembly.step sees channel DONE ── submit_system("weld", {actor, target, cause})
344	next tick P2: weld.validate (authoritative site; full can_join) ── weld.apply, one WriteScope:
345	   Graph.weld_join (M2) → Layout.attach_section (LM2) → Body.rebase_on_attach (BM3)
346	   → Interaction.sync_section × 2 → assembly.state
347	   each call returns OK or FAULT_CODE; first non-OK → ctx.fault() → kernel FAULTED (no rollback)
348	P5: one notification batch (graph, layout, body, interaction, assembly keys) + BODY_TRANSFER
349	   → PROJECTOR rebuild, Emitter re-derives body_id (W0), Lighting rebuilds occluders, camera rebase
350	Save/Load polls Assembly.last_shape_change_T() → ASSEMBLY_WELD autosave (subject to gates)
351	```
352	
353	Cut is the same shape with M3 → LM3 → BM4; install is a TAP command (Graph `check_install_module` → M5 → Suit `release_carried` → Controller `clear_carry_ref` → `sync_section`).
354	
355	### 4. Event and notification path
356	
357	- **Simulation → presentation:** P5 notification `(block_id, tick, change_keys)` with no state payload. Dirty keys are ints `(KIND << 32) | id`, namespaced per block. Past `MAX_DIRTY_KEYS` (256) a batch collapses to `ALL`. PRESENTATION, PROJECTOR and DIAGNOSTIC batches are merged across a multi-tick frame and delivered once; INPUT_SURFACE and REPLICATION get every tick.

### Presentation subscriber contract [PIPE PR-20, LO-1]

```gdscript
# Handler: a method Callable on a long-lived object (no lambda, no .bind()); never awaits (ADR-0004, ADR-0009 § 2).
func _on_changes(batch: ChangeBatch, ctx: NotifyContext) -> CompletionToken:  # marks dirty only; no draw, no read of other blocks
	_dirty.absorb(batch)                               # DirtyAccumulator (ADR-0004); a Dictionary.merge of a packed array was never valid
	return ctx.complete()                              # ADR-0003 callable contract, ADR-0009 § 2

# Presenters define no _process. PresentationDriver calls present(frame) once per frame, from PipelineRoot's single
# _process, in stage order (ADR-0009 § 3). Reads committed views at frame.alpha.
func present(frame: PresentFrame) -> void:
	if _dirty.is_empty() and not _animating():         # early-out only when both dirty and animating are empty (ADR-0009 § 2):
		return                                         # interpolation needs a draw on frames with no notification
	_redraw(frame.alpha)                               # alpha is frame.alpha, read once per frame; never Kernel.tick_alpha
```

### Presentation subscriber contract [PIPE PR-20, LO-1]

```gdscript
# Handler: a method Callable on a long-lived object (no lambda, no .bind()); never awaits (ADR-0004, ADR-0009 § 2).
func _on_changes(batch: ChangeBatch, ctx: NotifyContext) -> CompletionToken:  # marks dirty only; no draw, no read of other blocks
	_dirty.absorb(batch)                               # DirtyAccumulator (ADR-0004); a Dictionary.merge of a packed array was never valid
	return ctx.complete()                              # ADR-0003 callable contract, ADR-0009 § 2

# Presenters define no _process. PresentationDriver calls present(frame) once per frame, from PipelineRoot's single
# _process, in stage order (ADR-0009 § 3). Reads committed views at frame.alpha.
func present(frame: PresentFrame) -> void:
	if _dirty.is_empty() and not _animating():         # early-out only when both dirty and animating are empty (ADR-0009 § 2):
		return                                         # interpolation needs a draw on frames with no notification
	_redraw(frame.alpha)                               # alpha is frame.alpha, read once per frame; never Kernel.tick_alpha
```

content.content:
155	### 2. Dirty-mark-then-draw
156	
157	**The handler contract.** The kernel invokes each subscriber handler through a registered `Callable` with a reused `NotifyContext` (ADR-0003 § 3), exactly like every other kernel-invoked callable. The shape is ADR-0003's, as fixed by ADR-0004 § 2 (re-read 2026-10-28; it matches):
158	
159	```gdscript
160	func _on_changes(batch: ChangeBatch, ctx: NotifyContext) -> CompletionToken:
161		_dirty.absorb(batch)        # ADR-0004 DirtyAccumulator (capacity facet.key_capacity); allocates nothing; is_all on overflow
162		return ctx.complete()       # last statement; nothing follows it
163	```
164	
165	This replaces the architecture document's `-> void` example (§ GDD sync). A handler **must** do only this: copy the batch's keys into the presenter's pre-sized dirty structure, copy the scalar fields it needs from an event record into a fixed-size ring, and return. A handler **must never**: read a view, touch a node, create a `Callable` or a container, emit an engine signal, `await`, call `submit`, or write any property. A handler returns its `CompletionToken` synchronously, so `await` is banned **lexically** in any script registered through a `PresenterDescriptor` or that calls `.subscribe(` (ADR-0010 PRES rule, TD-16, with a bad fixture); the kernel's token-identity check is the runtime backstop and records anything other than the armed token, including a suspended coroutine state, as `INCOMPLETE` (ADR-0004 § 2), which counts against the handler. A handler fault is counted and never fatal (ADR-0003).
166	
167	**Why the handler does not draw.** It runs inside P5 with writes disabled and its cost is added to every other subscriber's; a catch-up frame already runs the tick loop up to four times (`MAX_TICKS_PER_FRAME`) and `INPUT_SURFACE` handlers run once per tick. Reading views there would also read a state that a later tick in the same frame is about to replace.
168	
169	**Delivery recap (properties this ADR relies on; ADR-0004 owns the mechanism):**
170	- PRESENTATION, PROJECTOR and DIAGNOSTIC batches arrive **once per rendered frame**, after the frame's last tick, one `ChangeBatch` per dirty block per subscription, with the union of the frame's keys (`is_all` true past `MAX_DIRTY_KEYS` 256; this text's "`ALL`" means `batch.is_all`). INPUT_SURFACE and REPLICATION get every tick's batch. A 0-tick frame delivers nothing.
171	- A restore delivers one `is_all` batch per block to every class when `LOADING` becomes `RUNNING`, with `batch.tick` set to the restored `T` (ADR-0004 P5/load delivery). **`ChangeBatch` carries no load marker, by design** (ADR-0004 § 6 states it; see `PresentationClock.load_seq`), so `is_all` is indistinguishable from a mass change; the restore edge is `load_seq` (§ 6).
172	- Notifications carry no state; event records (`BODY_TRANSFER`, `POD_ARRIVED`, `DERELICT_LOADED`) carry identifiers only.
173	
174	**The draw side.** Each presenter keeps two things, and its `present(frame)` early-outs only when both are empty:
175	- `dirty`: which blocks or keys changed since its last draw. Dirty drives **bulk and structural reads** (lists, queries, rebuilds, layout of plates): a presenter performs a bulk read of a block only when that block, or `ALL`, is dirty (TR-instr-005: derived inputs refresh once per Graph step because the Graph dirties its keys once per step, never per frame).
176	- `animating`: whether anything still moves on `tick_alpha` or `present_time` (an interpolated position, a needle ramp, a fade, flow scroll). **Interpolation needs a draw on frames with no notification**, because a 144 fps frame between two ticks has a new `tick_alpha` and no new state; the example in `architecture.md` that returns when `_dirty.is_empty()` would freeze motion on those frames and is corrected. Cheap scalar getters on the `interpolated` pair (previous and current position) may be read every frame while `animating`.
177	- `ALL` means "rebuild everything from the views, and draw the end state with no transition": the correct and sufficient response both to a restore and to a mass change. A presenter bounds a rebuild by its own budget (PROJECTOR: `BUILD_TILES_PER_FRAME`, chunked across frames, continuing to draw the last complete state until the chunks finish).
178	- Event records are copied into a fixed ring; ring overflow degrades to a full rebuild and counts `PRESENTER_EVENT_OVERFLOW`. Events are never dropped silently, and a `BODY_TRANSFER` is delivered to the camera as a rebase, not a cut (TR-shipbody-049; the rebase math is ADR-0008's).
179	
180	**Coherence by construction.** The driver runs inside `PipelineRoot._process` at `PRESENTATION` (0), after the TickDriver (-50) in the same `_process` pass, and the kernel cannot tick while presentation runs, so every presenter in a frame reads the same committed tick `T`. No presenter copies state to be consistent.
181	
182	**Latency, stated honestly.** Discrete committed state (a bead appears, a light toggles) is drawn in the same rendered frame as the P5 that announced it, with zero frames of delay (TR-assembly-045). Continuously interpolated motion lags the commit by up to one tick by construction, because `tick_alpha` is clamped at 1 and never extrapolates (PR-4 rule 3, PR-9 rate table).
183	
184	**A debug-build safety net, in addition to ADR-0004's check that every changed block marked a dirty key.** A presenter that applies **key-level incremental updates** (the PROJECTOR chunks, the Trail, Lighting's occluder builder) exposes `rebuild_signature() -> int` in debug and test builds only (a hash of its derived draw model). The dirty-correctness test (Validation) runs a scripted command stream through that incrementally updated presenter and a fresh presenter fed `ALL`, and requires equal signatures. A presenter that forgot to react to a key is caught by that test, not in play. A presenter that rebuilds a whole block whenever any of its keys is dirty is **exempt**, because the equivalence proves nothing for it. This is a story-level definition-of-done item for the presenter's story that references this ADR, not a blanket ADR requirement.

### Key Interfaces

```gdscript
class_name ContentLoader extends RefCounted
func _init(source: ContentSource, kernel_tick_rate: int) -> void: ...
func load_all() -> ContentLoadResult: ...      # the only entry; runs stages 1-4 of § 1.7

class_name ContentLoadResult extends RefCounted
var content: ContentSet        # null when errors is non-empty ("set" would clash with Object.set)
var errors: Array[BootError]   # empty on success; all errors of the failing stage
var stage_failed: int          # 0 = none, else 1..4

class_name BootError extends RefCounted
var code: int                  # (2 << 16) | local, ContentFaults
var table: StringName
var key: String
static func from_tables(scalars: ScalarTable, zoom_rows: Array[ZoomMinKRow]) -> RenderTuning   # built by the composition root
func tau_follow() -> float                  # seconds, converted at use from the SCALED field
func dt_max() -> float
func zoom_step_min_interval() -> float
func zoom_min_k(k_base: int, target_class: int) -> int

class_name RenderLayout extends RefCounted      # value; pure; no scene tree; fields are assigned in derive and never mutated afterwards
var window_px: Vector2i
var k_auto: int
var k_base: int
var k_z: int
var h: int
var field_px: Vector2i     # logical size in base px at k_z
var picture_rect: Rect2i   # screen px
var world_rect: Rect2i     # screen px, == field_px * k_z, centred in the picture
var hud_rect: Rect2i       # screen px, pinned to the k_base picture rect
var hud_canvas: Vector2    # hud_rect.size / h (may be fractional)
# No version field: PipelineRoot holds the layout version counter (a change counter is not part of a value).
static func derive(window_px: Vector2i, settings: DisplaySettings, zoom_k: int,
		tuning: RenderTuning, offered_h: Array[int]) -> RenderLayout   # offered_h is duplicated on entry
func world_to_hud(body_pos: Vector2i, pose_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2i       # the only form
func mouse_to_world_aim(cursor_px: Vector2i, f_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2    # open loop, D.14b
func mouse_to_world_view(cursor_px: Vector2i, pose_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2   # never for beam aim

class_name ViewportWiring extends RefCounted    # the ONLY reader of Mode; the only toucher of container / viewport / layer geometry
enum Mode { A, B }                              # a constructor argument, so the equivalence test can construct both (B built only if adopted)
func _init(mode: Mode) -> void                  # the composition root passes the default from one build constant or feature tag
func apply(layout: RenderLayout) -> void        # tracks the desired render_target_update_mode itself; never reads the property back
func read_back() -> WiringReadback              # effective world and HUD scales, sizes, filters (§ 5.4)

class_name PipelineRoot extends Node            # process_priority = ProcessPriority.PRESENTATION; the single PresentationHost (ADR-0009 § 3)
func setup(clock: PresentationClock, driver: PresentationDriver, tuning: RenderTuning,
		settings: DisplaySettings, hud_layout: HudLayout) -> void   # PresentationClock only: no kernel-state view type exists
func request_zoom_step(direction: int) -> void        # +1 zoom in, -1 zoom out; edge-triggered; rate-limited

### Content loader [ADR-0007 § 1.7, § 2.3]

```gdscript

class_name ContentLoader extends RefCounted
func _init(source: ContentSource, kernel_tick_rate: int) -> void
func load_all() -> ContentLoadResult

class_name ContentLoadResult extends RefCounted

*(Amended 2026-10-29 — ADR-0007 sync)* On any error the composition root never starts the kernel. `ContentSet` is frozen and read-only; catalogs reach modules as their own `setup()` arguments. Only `src/data/` may use `FileAccess`, `DirAccess` or `JSON` for content (lint, ADR-0010).

### Pipeline root and render layout [ADR-0008 § 3, § 6; PIPE PR-12, PR-20]

```gdscript
class_name PipelineRoot extends Node             # process_priority = ProcessPriority.PRESENTATION; the single PresentationHost
func setup(clock: PresentationClock, driver: PresentationDriver, tuning: RenderTuning,
		settings: DisplaySettings, hud_layout: HudLayout) -> void
func request_zoom_step(direction: int) -> void   # +1 in, -1 out; edge-triggered; rate-limited

class_name RenderLayout extends RefCounted       # pure value; written only by PipelineRoot; handed out read-only
func world_to_hud(body_pos: Vector2i, pose_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2i          # the only projection to HUD coordinates; floored to the HUD grid
func mouse_to_world_aim(cursor_px: Vector2i, f_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2       # open loop (D.14b); the only mapping that feeds beam aim
func mouse_to_world_view(cursor_px: Vector2i, pose_q: Vector2i) -> Vector2   # picking and pings; never beam aim (lint, ADR-0010)
```

*(Amended 2026-10-29 — ADR-0008 sync)* `PipelineRoot` is the only writer of viewport, container and layer geometry; the camera is solved in the `CAMERA_SOLVE` stage and `frame_pre_draw` only writes `canvas_transform` and the parallax offsets. Subscribers receive `RenderLayout` read-only and re-derive nothing.

258	Engine frame (_process order by process_priority)
259	│
260	├─ INPUT_ADAPTER (-100)  Input Adapter (INPUT_SURFACE; the only presentation-side node below the driver's priority, so the KRN-LAT-02 priority lint exempts INPUT_SURFACE nodes)
261	│     read InputMap actions → change-only intents (set_move_intent, set_aim ≤ every 3 ticks)
262	│     → surface.submit(type, payload, actor, correlation)           [sync call on the Adapter's SurfaceHandle (ADR-0002), queued]
263	│
264	├─ TICK_DRIVER (-50)  KernelHost → TickDriver (the only wall-clock read that reaches the sim)
265	│     boundary service first (SAVING / LOADING / pause / resume; a frame that ends in a transition into RUNNING clears the accumulator and discards its own delta)
266	│     then, while RUNNING: acc += delta_us × TICK_RATE ; ticks = min(floor(acc / 1e6), MAX_TICKS_PER_FRAME=4)
267	│     repeat ticks times: Kernel.step()  ──► P0 Begin
268	│                                           P1 Intake   (queue → this tick's batch, coalesce intents)
269	│                                           P2 Dispatch (authority check → validate → apply in WriteScope)
270	│                                           P3 Step     (hooks whose T mod divisor == offset, topo order)
271	│                                           P4 Commit
272	│                                           P5 Notify   (batches queued; PRESENTATION merged per frame)
273	│                                           P6 Boundary (snapshot/restore/pause requests)
274	│     drop lag (LAG_FORGIVE_TICKS 0) ; flush results ; compute tick_alpha ; Kernel.deliver_frame_end() (unconditional last step of the driver frame)
275	│
276	├─ HOST_SERVICE (-40)  SaveHost (src/game/save_host.gd; the only user of this priority, ADR-0006)
277	│     SaveService.poll_frame(): observes the last committed tick boundary; polls the worker; no presentation work
278	│
279	└─ PRESENTATION (0)  PipelineRoot._process = the single PresentationHost (ADR-0008 s6.1, ADR-0009 s3); presenters define no _process
280	      subscriber handlers (run in P5) only mark dirty: _dirty.absorb(batch); return ctx.complete()
281	      advance present_time → zoom cooldown → RESCALING re-derive if the layout is dirty → driver.frame(delta, present_time)
282	      driver.frame fills one PresentFrame (alpha read once, pos = floor(prev + (curr - prev) × frame.alpha)), then runs the stages in order:
283	        0 PROJECT (layout projector, body.projector, Lighting's occluder builder) → 1 CAMERA_SOLVE (CameraSolver: pose_q, f_q, jolt, parallax offsets, world_to_hud inputs; solved, not yet written)
284	        → 2 AVATAR (Avatar Presenter) → 3 FILTER (Perception Filter step, decoy list) → 4 INSTRUMENTS (perceived()) → 5 HUD (perceived(); world_to_hud with this frame's pose)
285	        → 6 LIGHTING → 7 TRAIL → 8 AUDIO → 9 DEBUG
286	      RenderingServer.frame_pre_draw (probed after every node _process, windowed 4.7.2 editor; release export unverified): writes canvas_transform and the parallax offsets only, from the already-solved pose
287	```
288	
289	*(Amended 2026-10-29 — ADR-0001 / ADR-0008 / ADR-0009 sync)* Frame order is the named constants of ADR-0001 § 2: `INPUT_ADAPTER` -100, `TICK_DRIVER` -50, `HOST_SERVICE` -40, `PRESENTATION` 0 (no `PRESENTATION_LATE`); there is no "priority 2". If `frame_pre_draw` fails the release-export spike (ADR-0008 pipeline spike step 12), the canvas write moves to the end of `PipelineRoot._process`.
290	
291	**P3 hook schedule (MVP).** Divisor and offset decide which ticks a hook runs on; `after:` orders hooks that run on the same tick. An `after:` edge between hooks that do not always run on the same tick should declare `tolerates_stale` (CR-3); an undeclared one boots with a warning (ruling R-8), so the warning list must be empty at the end of every CI run.
